Tessa — suggested edits to the TTL language below (keeping it tight for SIG reviewers):

- Request metadata (headers, routing, request size): retained 30 days by default; aggregated metrics retained longer in analytics buckets.
- Request/response index (pointers to payload storage/diagnostic refs): retained 90 days; payloads are stored in an encrypted cold store with a 90-180 day retention depending on customer settings.
- Auditor snapshots / forensic exports: retained up to 180 days by default; can be extended temporarily under legal hold.

On masking: we apply deterministic redaction on recognized PII fields (SSNs, emails, phone numbers) at ingestion. For debug dumps that must preserve request shape for troubleshooting, we provide a hashed identifier map (one-way SHA-256 with salt) rather than reversible masking.

On approvals: temporary extensions are recorded in Jira ticket type SEC-RETENTION with explicit approvers (Security PM + Legal) and an expiry date; the ticket, approver emails, and an automated audit log entry are part of the evidence bundle.

I'll add the two examples of past extensions (one PCI investigation, one customer legal hold) to the evidence zip.

— Priyom
